tools.name: tenant_law
tools.description: Verified landlord-tenant rules for one US state, checked against the official statutes: security deposit limit and return deadline, late-fee rules, landlord entry notice, notice to end a month-to-month tenancy, rent-increase notice, repairs, retaliation, and lease clauses that are commonly unenforce

tools.name: check_lease
tools.description: Scan a US residential lease for risky, unusual or likely unenforceable clauses under that state's tenant law. Pass the full lease text. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_lease · Public sink: check_lease.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_lease · Public sink: check_lease

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
